simple.meaning: מִנְחָה (minchâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a sacrificial offering.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 7:17. Its contexts include offering, altar, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִנְחָה (H4504).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מִנְחָה (minchâh) / H4504 is traced through Ezra 7:17, Daniel 2:46 as a generated source-based concept entry.
